scope: Abaqus 2025 cites TNSB Rev.3 October1990; COMSOL6.4 independently specifies the signed top-D target. Original P18 benchmark sheet and amendment details were not acquired.

boundary_conditions.selection: outer elliptical side curve at z=300 mm ONLY

target.extraction: Extrapolated and averaged nodal stress at the exact D corner node; preserve all raw nodal components and integration-point stresses. No nearest-Gauss-point, magnitude, von-Mises or global-maximum substitution.
target.sign_note: Abaqus reference prose prints +5.38; its Standard tables are negative. COMSOL explicitly gives -5.38 at (2,0,0.6)m. Use the signed value; original P18 sign text remains UNKNOWN.

static_scope.density: Not used; vendor densities differ and are irrelevant to this static zero-body-force case.

mesh_sequence.rule: Explicit seed edge(2,3) midpoint105->205 correction before ELGEN. Keep original raw asset unchanged and quarantined; verify corrected shared edges and coordinates against fine-source coarsening.
Uniform factor2 subdivision in all3 natural directions of each vendor fine HEXA20; interpolate its geometry, share matching nodes and preserve exact D/support planes.
Uniform factor4 subdivision in all3 natural directions of each vendor fine HEXA20; same geometry/reference and no threshold change.

metric_conventions.cross_solver_difference: abs(sigma_yy_D_A - sigma_yy_D_B)/abs(reference_mpa) on each identical finest shared mesh
metric_conventions.reaction: Recover support reaction components, correcting RF for applied loads when necessary; deduplicate constrained node/component pairs. Exact equilibrium error = max(abs(Rx),abs(Ry),abs(Rz-pressure_mpa*A_loaded_mm2))/(pressure_mpa*A_loaded_mm2). Preserve each signed resultant and actual curved-face integrated area separately from analytical-area comparison.
metric_conventions.analytic_geometry: A = pi*(3250*2750-2000*1000)/4 mm^2; V = 600*A mm^3. Area and volume errors are abs(actual-analytic)/abs(analytic).
metric_conventions.coarse_scope: Keep all raw source defects and numerical errors. Abaqus published C3D20 coarse error25%/fine4.83% are vendor results, not reproduced project results. Original public coarse input is nonconforming and must be refused before solving. Its explicit corrected derivative is a new mesh identity; only the predeclared finest result is subject to the final5% gate. Do not claim monotonic error improvement from arbitrary nodal averaging.
metric_conventions.jacobian_scope: Check quadrature and declared additional sampling locations on curved HEXA20; a sampled positive minimum is not a proof of global positivity everywhere.
metric_conventions.geometry_scope: Vendor rounded quadratic mesh geometry; all-direction refinements subdivide that same represented geometry. This is not an exact analytic-ellipse CAD-parent fixture analysis.

source_topology_disposition.finding: Official nle10fkc.inp seed slot10 uses105 for edge5-405; adjacent generated element uses205. Coordinates differ. The defect propagates under ELGEN, including a lower/upper interface. Raw expansion has12elements121active/465source nodes, rather than conforming111 active nodes.

correction.stage: Normalized seed connectivity before ELGEN only

source_topology_disposition.requirements: Original downloaded bytes/SHA256 are never edited. Retain raw rejected topology/check evidence and the correction manifest, compare all corrected nodes to the fine-source catalogue, verify every shared edge and full geometry before solving. Record a distinct normalized mesh hash; no claim of reproducing the published original coarse output.
source_topology_disposition.fine: Public fine input is conforming:48elements349active/465source nodes. All-direction refinements interpolate this unmodified fine geometry.

quality_sampling.volume_rule: Tensor-product 3-point Gauss-Legendre integration: each natural coordinate in [-sqrt(3/5),0,sqrt(3/5)] with weights [5/9,8/9,5/9], all27 points.
quality_sampling.additional_jacobian_rule: All27 tensor-product locations with each natural coordinate in [-1,0,1] (8 corners,12 edge midpoints,6 face centers and center). Evaluate both27-point lists; the center is checked twice,54 evaluations per element.
quality_sampling.loaded_face_rule: Top natural face zeta=+1, tensor-product 3-point Gauss-Legendre quadrature,9 points per loaded Q8 face. Preserve the vector area normal, not just corner polygon area.
quality_sampling.limitations: Sampled Jacobian positivity is an admission check, not proof of positivity at every location. All refinements interpolate and integrate the same quadratic vendor geometry.

allowed_research_conditions.reference_scaling: For admitted pressure p, signed_reference_mpa=-5.38*(p/1 MPa), from linearity at identical canonical material/zero prescribed displacement BCs and geometry. The fixed source reference remains -5.38 MPa at1 MPa; reference override is refused.
allowed_research_conditions.material: Canonical E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3 are fixed for this published stress reference.
allowed_research_conditions.mesh_levels: Ordered prefixes of2..4 frozen levels are executable; full four-level acceptance requires all4. Partial studies retain their values and fail the full-sequence gate.

bounded_changed_condition.reason: Linearity with identical zero-displacement BCs/material/geometry; no physical material qualification.

primary_documents.scope: Catalog confirms LE10 magnitude/location amendment and later revision; not the original full sheet.
Rev3-cited definition, native inputs and nonmonotonic nodal-average effects; published output is not this project's solver result.
Complete construction/BCs/signed top-D target and singular support limitation; public PDF retrieval was intermittently unavailable.
Installed-version native output semantics: RF is external force, FRD stresses are extrapolated/averaged; no new solver version adopted.
